recap.title: Halcyon City Overcomes Redmarsh Rovers' Early Dominance to Win 4-2
recap.standfirst: Despite Redmarsh Rovers' initial control and higher xG, Halcyon City capitalized on key moments and numerical advantage to secure a 4-2 victory.

paragraphs.text: The match started with Redmarsh Rovers seizing early momentum, dominating possession at over 63% by the 7th minute and creating high-quality chances, including a blocked 0.91 xG shot by Luca Rask. However, Halcyon City struck first against the run of play with Bastian Fontaine's counter-attack goal at 11:55, disrupting Redmarsh's control and forcing them to respond. (moment_ids: ["SS00076-M001","SS00076-M002","SS00076-M003"], facts: ["stats.Redmarsh Rovers.possession_pct","potm.1.xg","potm.1.name","stats.Halcyon City.goals"])

Redmarsh quickly equalized through Isak Quarry's header at 14:25, regaining momentum with increased possession and shots. For much of the first half, Redmarsh maintained control, holding up to 73% possession and doubling Halcyon's pressing actions. Despite this, Halcyon City's pressing spells began disrupting Redmarsh's rhythm, leading to turnovers and a more balanced contest approaching halftime. (moment_ids: ["SS00076-M006","SS00076-M009","SS00076-M012","SS00076-M013"], facts: ["stats.Redmarsh Rovers.possession_pct","stats.Redmarsh Rovers.shots","stats.Halcyon City.ppda"])

The second half saw a shift to chaos with rapid possession changes, but Redmarsh took the lead at 51:59 with Luca Rask's counter goal. Shortly after, Redmarsh was reduced to 10 men following a second yellow card to Kian Steen, yet remarkably maintained momentum and pressure. Halcyon City responded by intensifying pressing efforts, exploiting Redmarsh's fatigue and reduced passing accuracy to regain control in the final stages. (moment_ids: ["SS00076-M016","SS00076-M018","SS00076-M019","SS00076-M021","SS00076-M022"], facts: ["potm.1.name","stats.Redmarsh Rovers.players_on_pitch","stats.Redmarsh Rovers.pass_completion"])

Halcyon City's persistence paid off late in the match as they seized momentum with a series of box entries and shots, culminating in Ezra Lazaro's equalizer at 79:46. They then took the lead through Lenny Amsel's header at 86:06 and sealed the win with Lazaro's second goal in stoppage time. Despite having lower overall xG (2.36 to 5.02), Halcyon's clinical finishing and sustained pressure, especially with a full squad against ten, proved decisive. (moment_ids: ["SS00076-M023","SS00076-M025","SS00076-M030","SS00076-M031"], facts: ["stats.Halcyon City.xg","stats.Redmarsh Rovers.xg","stats.Halcyon City.players_on_pitch","stats.Redmarsh Rovers.players_on_pitch"])

recap.player_of_the_match_reason: Ezra Lazaro was instrumental in Halcyon City's comeback, scoring two crucial goals including the equalizer and the late winner, while also providing an assist and covering the most distance on the pitch, demonstrating his pivotal role in the team's offensive and defensive efforts.
